implementations.name: datalayer-py
relaxations: INTEROP_ALLOW_TEST_HOSTS=1: a Reactor URL-safety contribution (adapter, not a patch) lets discovery and metadata fetches reach *.interop.test hosts on private addresses; other hosts keep the SDK's public-address policy
Trusts the per-run CA at /interop/ca.pem (the adapter builds the httpx client the SDK is given)

implementations.name: pi-poppy
relaxations: PI_POPPY_INTEROP_PRIVATE_SUFFIX=.interop.test (patches/0001): host names under .interop.test may resolve to private addresses; unset by default, loopback still refused
Client metadata and JWKS are served by pi-poppy's IdentityServer handler on plain HTTP at the interop origin behind the proxy, instead of its own loopback HTTPS listener
The interop CA is trusted through NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS (pi-poppy's `ca` option is left unset)

implementations.name: datalayer-ts
relaxations: organization.domain and auth.issuer set to datalayer-ts.company.interop.test (Manzanita's config.domain; upstream default manzanita.example)

implementations.name: datalayer-py
relaxations: INTEROP_ALLOW_TEST_HOSTS=1: a Reactor URL-safety contribution (adapter, not a patch) lets the Company fetch client metadata and JWKS from *.interop.test hosts on private addresses; other hosts keep the SDK's public-address policy
Trusts the per-run CA at /interop/ca.pem for those fetches (the adapter builds the httpx client the SDK is given)
Organization domain and issuer come from INTEROP_ORIGIN instead of manzanita.example

implementations.name: pi-poppy
relaxations: PI_POPPY_INTEROP_PRIVATE_SUFFIX=.interop.test (patches/0001): client_id and jwks_uri under .interop.test may resolve to private addresses; unset by default, loopback still refused
CompanyServer's request handler is served on plain HTTP behind the proxy with baseUrl set to the interop origin, instead of its own 127.0.0.1 HTTPS listener
The interop CA is trusted through NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS (CompanyServer's `ca` option is left unset)
